Aging Adults:

In adults, systolic blood pressure rises from early adulthood onward, up to at least age 70. Diastolic pressure tends to begin to rise at the same time but starts to fall earlier in mid-life, approximately age 55. Mean blood pressure rises from early adulthood, plateauing in mid-life, while pulse pressure rises quite markedly after the age of 40.

CHAT WITH A DOCTOR USING VIDEO

Are you suffering from a cold, flu or allergy? Would you like to discuss your symptoms with a doctor? The chat with our general practitioners is a professional, fast and safe contact point for general health questions.

You will receive competent advice and a recommendation for action from the doctor. If necessary, you will be referred to a physical doctor or specialist. A video function is also available. With the doctors’ chat, you can count on optimal advice and quality care at any time – wherever you happen to be.

PRESCRIPTION RENEWAL

Leave a prescription renewal request for a doctor. It will be handled within moments and you will be notified when the doctor has renewed your prescription.

DIGITAL HEALTH EXAMINATION

The digital health examination assesses your risks of diabetes and cardiovascular diseases. You can also get information on your kidney, liver and thyroid health as well as your iron supplies and vitamin D levels. Our digital clinic doctors will advise you both before and after the examinations, and you will receive recommendations for a healthy lifestyle and additional examinations if necessary.

Mizu helps you manage your chronic kidney disease (CKD) with a vital parameters logbook, kidney-specific food diary, medication tracking, educational resources and travel dialysis finder. 

Mizu is here to help you no matter what your chronic kidney disease (CKD) progression level is. You can use the app in early-stage of CKD, undergoing regular dialysis treatment as well as living with a functioning kidney transplant. 

Mizu was developed in close collaboration with leading nephrologists, university hospitals, patients and caregivers. We have ongoing partnerships with several patient associations and support networks, as well as medical research institutions.

Download for free now and master your renal condition with validated tools and resources.


*** How will Mizu help you? ***

Keep track of everything you need to do today
• Log important health parameters and drug intakes based on your CKD stage
• Track what you eat and drink to better understand how it impacts your health
• Receive automated reminders for all medications based on your individual medication plan

Track your health & stay on top of trends
• Create a weekly routine to log the health parameters that are most important to you and your CKD stage
• Keep an eye especially on those parameters that you can influence through your own lifestyle such as potassium, phosphate, tacrolimus, eGFR, ACR, CRP, body temperature, leucocytes and more
• If you also have hypertension or diabetes, you can monitor blood pressure, HbA1c, blood sugar levels and other glucose-related parameters as well
• Are you a kidney transplant recipient? Closely monitor your graft’s health with it and ensure that your medication dosage is in line with your vital parameters and immunosuppressive levels to optimize your graft’s lifetime

Know what you eat & drink
• Get CKD-specific nutrient breakdowns for thousands of food, dishes, drinks and kidney-friendly recipes based on your personal reference values
• Drill down especially on your intake of proteins, potassium, sodium, carbohydrates, calories, phosphate, as well as your fluid intake
• Track what you eat and drink for several days to better understand how it impacts your health and further optimize your renal diet
• Let Mizu support you with achieving a diet based on your personal needs such as low-salt, protein-rich or protein-low, low phosphate, low potassium, mediterranean diet or ways to reduce your bodyweight

Become a CKD expert
• Learn about countless tops, tricks & articles to live your best normal life
• Customized content based on your CKD stage (prevention of ESRD, transplant recipient or on dialysis)
• All content is validated by doctors and regular checked and improved to ensure reliable information
• On dialysis or living with a new graft? Plan your next trip with Mizu’s directory of 5000+ renal institutions worldwide. It includes transplant centers, nephrologists, dialysis centers, shunt centers and more
• Find communities, organizations and other associations that focus on supporting people living with CKD and get to know other people affected by CKD this way


*** Mizu's Vision ***

Our mission is to make a positive contribution to improving the treatment of chronic kidney disease and slowing down its progression. This applies to both improvements in the everyday life of those affected as well as in that of the treating physicians and therapists.
